name: informatica-etl-conversion
description: Convert Informatica PowerCenter mappings into Snowflake or Databricks pipelines: toolkit agent etl-extract behind a dry-run cost gate turns mapping XML into dataspecs, agent discovery resolves each against the target warehouse into a data contract, a grouped human-review queue drives those contracts to approved, and agent pipeline-build generates the transforms, tests, and synthetic-data spec. Converts one migration-plan group at a time, or a whole small corpus in a single pass when there is no plan.
